nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

A method and system for determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to specified parameters.

A type determined by the meaning of a term of the short message that provides information about the context or environment of the device that generated the short message.<SEP>A classification of context data determined from a query or from the meaning of a term in a short message, providing information about the environment of a mobile device.<SEP>A type algorithmically determined by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about an environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides a context-data type and provides context data with a cost value.<SEP>A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested and acquired.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type; sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost.

A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type.<SEP>A message generated by a mobile device that may be associated with context data, appended with context data, and forwarded to a recipient mobile device.<SEP>A message generated by a device to which relevant context-data is linked.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type; context data may be linked and formatted with it.

A device that generates a short message or query and to which received context data may be provided.<SEP>A device that sends short messages and receives context data through a communication network; context data may be appended to short messages generated by the mobile device.

A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.<SEP>At least one server that collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.
A mobile device that receives context data, short messages, and forwarded messages with associated context data.

A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may comprise a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A parameter used to rank context-data sources or context data, including pecuniary cost, state of the receiving mobile device, and state of an available communication network.<SEP>A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from a source.
A specified parameter representing the monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.
A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

A server that stores a database and sends context data to a receiving mobile device.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
Instructions appended to query the database for received context data in the short message.<SEP>Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.

An available communication network whose state may comprise a specified parameter.<SEP>An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking.<SEP>A network through which context data is communicated to a mobile device.
A mobile device that receives a short message and context data from a database server.

Data provided by a context-data source, associated with a context-data type and having a cost value.<SEP>Data of a context-data type requested from a context-data source, obtained by a physical sensor, and rendered or appended for communication to a mobile device.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute the program instructions.

A component of the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions to perform operations such as receiving a short message and determining a context-data type.<SEP>At least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations including receiving short messages, determining context-data types, identifying and ranking sources, and generating requests.
A component of the computerized apparatus having program instructions.

A provider of context-data that may be allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a set of context data related to a meaning of short message content is collected by a server.
A sensor that obtains context-data through physical sensing.<SEP>A sensor by which context data is obtained.
A metric according to which relevant context data is algorithmically selected, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.

A protocol according to which the relevant context-data and the short message are formatted.<SEP>A protocol according to which relevant context data and the short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.
A type of communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric, from which context data is selected.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted according to a communication protocol.
A cost associated with the context-data that a context-data provider may be allowed to provide.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The method determines a context-data type from a query or from the meaning of a term of a short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source that provides the context-data type and generates a request for context data from that source.
The method algorithmically ranks context-data sources or received context data according to a specified parameter.
The received context data may be provided to the device that generated the short message.
The received context data may be provided to a recipient mobile device.
The received context data may be associated with a component of a short message and appended to the short message.
The received context data may be encoded into the short message with a markup language.
The received context data may be stored in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The context-data type is determined by the meaning of a term of the short message.
The context-data type provides information about the environment of the mobile device.
The context-data source provides the context-data type.
The processor is configured to algorithmically determine a context-data type.<SEP>The processor algorithmically determines a context-data type based on the meaning of a term of the short message.
The context-data type provides information about an environment of the mobile device.

The context-data source is algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>The context-data source is algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter comprising a pecuniary cost.
The processor identifies at least one context-data source that provides the context-data type and algorithmically ranks it according to a specified parameter.
A request for context data of the context-data type is generated to the context-data source.
The server receives a short message from a mobile device.
The mobile device generates a short message and a query.
The short message and the received context data may be forwarded to the recipient mobile device.
Metadata instructions to query the database for the received context data may be appended to the short message.
The mobile device that generated the short message may comprise a smart phone.

The processor is configured to execute instructions to perform receiving a short message from a mobile device.<SEP>The processor is configured to execute program instructions to perform the operation of receiving a short message from a mobile device.

Context data from the context-data source is appended to a short message generated by the mobile device.<SEP>The collected context data is related to a meaning of a short message content.<SEP>The relevant context data is linked to the short message.
